protocol.type: Firebase Cloud Functions callable (httpsCallable) qua custom domain
protocol.custom_domain_source: Remote Config key functions_domains, default ["https://api.locketcamera.com"], chon ngau nhien 1 entry, cache; rong/null -> SDK fallback us-central1

headers.Authorization: Bearer <Firebase ID token, SDK tu gan>

protocol.response_validation: validateFunctionResponseWithNestedData: throw neu status >= 400 hoac errors non-empty; message = errors[0] hoac 'Unknown cloud function error'

status_codes.304: Khong co moment moi (getLatestMomentV2, dung cache)
status_codes.600: Da ton tai (sendVerificationCode: ExistingPhoneNumber; validateEmailAddress: email da thuoc tk khac)
status_codes.601: Khong tim thay / da dung (sendVerificationCode: UnknownPhoneNumber; updateEmailAddress: email_already_in_use)

step1_request: use_password_if_available (tu RC android_auth_config, default true; chi co o onboarding, khong co o doi so)
phone_otp_2step.step2_method_firebase: data.method == 'firebase' -> Firebase signInWithPhoneNumber(phone, forceResend=true) -> SMS OTP -> confirmation.confirm(code)
phone_otp_2step.step2_method_other: checkVerificationCode({phone, verification_code}) -> data.token -> signInWithCustomToken(token); khong check status, chi check token co mat
phone_otp_2step.change_number: sendVerificationCode({phone, operation: 'change_number', device_model}) roi confirm: co Firebase confirmation object -> confirmation.confirm(code), khong co -> verifyEditedPhoneNumber({phone, verification_code}), loi neu data.error hoac status >= 400

email.signup: androidSignupRecaptchaEnabled()==false -> createAccountWithEmailPassword({email, password}); ==true -> thu AppCheck truoc, co token -> V1 (token do Functions SDK gan, khong nam trong body); AppCheck null -> reCAPTCHA Enterprise (RecaptchaAction SIGNUP) -> createAccountWithEmailPasswordV2({email, password, recaptcha_token}); response data.token -> signInWithCustomToken
email.reset_password: sendPasswordResetEmail({email} neu authType email, {phone} neu khac); yeu cau status 200
email.validate_email: validateEmailAddress({email, operation: 'create_account'}); status 600 = email da ton tai
email.finalize_temporary_user: finalizeTemporaryUser({first_name, last_name, require_username, username}); yeu cau status 200 roi updateProfile displayName
email.username: validateUsername({username}), validateUsernameV2({username, recaptcha_token}), setUsername({username}), setUsernameV2({username, recaptcha_token}), suggestUsernames({first_name, last_name}), getUserByUsername({username})
email.note: Email KHONG dang nhap truc tiep bang FirebaseAuth.signInWithEmail nhu naive-locket 2024; tat ca qua callable cua server

appcheck_recaptcha.appcheck_provider: Play Integrity (debug khi co co debug); initializeAppCheck isTokenAutoRefreshEnabled=true; getAppCheckToken(context, screen) dung o buoc signup email truoc reCAPTCHA
appcheck_recaptcha.recaptcha: reCAPTCHA Enterprise; RecaptchaAction LOGIN='login', SIGNUP='signup', custom(action); RC gates (default true): android_signup_recaptcha_enabled, android_usernames_recaptcha_enabled, android_friending_recaptcha_enabled, android_group_membership_recaptcha_enabled, android_data_export_recaptcha_enabled, android_location_caption_recaptcha_enabled
appcheck_recaptcha.recaptcha_token_in_body: createAccountWithEmailPasswordV2, sendFriendRequestV2, validateUsernameV2, setUsernameV2, requestUserDataExport (khi gate bat), groupUserOp/createGroup (co field recaptcha_token)

token_refresh.id_token: RNFB Auth getIdToken() / getIdTokenResult(); Groups WS goi getIdToken(true) truoc khi ket noi
token_refresh.refresh: Ngoai JS bundle: 0 hit securetoken/grant_type/refresh_token/expiresIn trong decompiled.js; chi co trong native RNFB Auth SDK (dex strings: securetoken.googleapis.com/v1, identitytoolkit.googleapis.com/v2). Firebase Auth SDK tu refresh qua POST securetoken.googleapis.com/v1/token; grant_type=refresh_token, expiresIn=3600 la chuan Firebase Auth, CHUA xac minh tu bundle nay (Wan 1.1.9 dung dung co che nay o native TokenModule)
